question: 'A Shot at History: My Obsessive Journey to Olympic Gold', is the autobiography of which of the following Olympian?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Abhinav Bindra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Abhinav Bindra** is an Indian Olympic shooter and the first Indian to win an individual Olympic gold medal.
 
• Bindra won the gold medal in the 10m Air Rifle event at the 2008 Beijing Olympics.
 
• His autobiography, *A Shot at History: My Obsessive Journey to Olympic Gold*, was published in 2011.
 
• Besides his Olympic success, Bindra has also won multiple medals in the World Championships, Commonwealth Games, and Asian Games.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Major Dhyan Chand**

 
 
• Major Dhyan Chand was an Indian field hockey player and is regarded as one of the greatest in the history of the sport.
 
• He won three Olympic gold medals for India in 1928, 1932, and 1936.
 
• Known as "The Wizard" for his superb ball control, Chand scored over 400 goals during his international career.
 
 
 
• **Avani Lekhara**
 
 
• Avani Lekhara is an Indian Paralympic shooter.
 
• She won a gold medal in the 10m Air Rifle Standing event at the Tokyo 2020 Paralympics, becoming the first Indian woman to win a Paralympic gold medal.
 
• She also won a bronze medal in the 50m Rifle 3 Positions SH1 event at the same games.
 
 
 
• **Neeraj Chopra**
 
 
• Neeraj Chopra is an Indian javelin thrower and a track and field athlete.
 
• He won the gold medal in the men's javelin throw at the Tokyo 2020 Olympics, becoming the first Indian to win an Olympic gold medal in athletics.
 
• Chopra is also a Junior World Record holder and has won multiple medals in the Asian Games and Commonwealth Games.
